description: This file implements the AttachSource class and related helper classes for managing media source capabilities and appsrc elements in a GStreamer-based media pipeline. It handles creating media caps, switching sources, and configuring appsrc elements for audio and video streams within a media pipeline.

classes.name: MediaSourceCapsBuilder
classes.description: Base class for building media source capabilities, including common caps and specific configurations for audio, video, and Dolby Vision sources.

classes.name: MediaSourceAudioCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building audio media caps, including special handling for Opus and MPEG audio types.

classes.name: MediaSourceVideoCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building video media caps, including width and height parameters.

classes.name: MediaSourceVideoDolbyVisionCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building Dolby Vision video caps, adding specific Dolby Vision parameters.

classes.name: AttachSource
classes.description: Main class responsible for attaching media sources to the GStreamer pipeline, creating caps, switching sources, and configuring appsrc elements.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the process of creating caps from the media source, adding or switching the source in the pipeline.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Adds a new appsrc element to the pipeline for the specified media source.

methods.name: updateSource
methods.description: Updates the caps of an existing appsrc element if they differ from the new caps.

methods.name: switchAudioSource
methods.description: Handles switching the audio source, including performing codec/channel switch and updating internal state.

methods.name: createCapsFromMediaSource
methods.description: Creates GstCaps based on the media source type (audio, video, Dolby Vision).

methods.name: createAudioAttributes
methods.description: Constructs audio attributes for use in switching audio streams.
